verdict.rationale: Penpot publishes a pricing page, but the evidence only shows generic plan features: unlimited teams, no file limits within storage capacity, and community plugins. It does not show how seats, tiers or AI features are structured or gated. missing for 10: named plan tiers with prices, seat-type definitions (e.g. editor vs viewer), AI/MCP feature gating per plan, self-host vs cloud pricing distinctions, independent corroboration of pricing clarity.
